visual_action: The video starts with a clip of Donald Trump outdoors, wearing a suit and holding a large board with a picture of a classical building on it, obscuring his torso. The video then cuts to a still photograph of Donald Trump sitting in a golf cart, wearing a polo shirt, a red "MAKE AMERICA GREAT AGAIN" hat, and a golf glove. His midsection is visible in the photo.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is the only person shown and heard in the video. The first clip shows him speaking, and the second is a still photograph of him.

on_screen_text.text: YOU DON'T HAVE TO LOOK AT

spoken_summary: Donald Trump says, "See, I look so thin. They'll say, 'Oh, he's gotten so thin,' 'cause I'm holding this. You don't have to look at my waist, you can look at this."
audio_music: The first part of the video features only Donald Trump's voice. When the video cuts to the still photograph of him, a single, loud, dramatic booming sound effect plays to create a comedic, mocking emphasis.
editing_pacing: The video uses a simple setup-punchline structure. A clip of Donald Trump speaking is followed by a hard cut to a contrasting still photograph, timed to his words for comedic effect.
central_claim: The video mocks Donald Trump's vanity by juxtaposing his comments about looking thin with a photograph in which he appears overweight.
intended_effect: To make the audience laugh at Donald Trump and perceive him as out of touch with reality about his appearance.
